metadata.ogDescription: CNAP Financial Awards Partner with CNAP and take advantage of the various financial awards that are available to benefit SNF workforce development initiatives in California. You may be eligible for multiple awards depending on your facilities needs and goals, and may apply for all awards through one single application. Applications must be received for each…

children.value: "We just received our first check for the CNAP program for the 18 CNAs that we put through our CNA class. All our interactions with Mai and Zane have been nothing short of amazing. They were with us the entire way and felt invested in our success. Their instructions were clear and concise, and they went above and beyond to ensure we received our reward. We will gladly continue to work with them in future cohorts and are grateful for this partnership."

children.value: “We are thrilled with the CNAP funds received as they have provided us with the financial flexibility to enhance our classrooms and work stations for both our employee students and long-term staff. Thanks to CNAP we can invest in improvements that directly benefit our learning environment and support our educational goals. The process of accessing the funds was straightforward and we appreciate the opportunity to utilize them for our specific needs. CNAP has truly made a positive impact on our facility, and we look forward to our continued partnership.”

children.value: “Our experience with the CNAP program has been incredibly beneficial to our facility. With our second cohort of Earn and Learn students graduating soon and another one planned for the near future, CNAP has played a vital role in addressing our staffing needs. Thanks to the Earn and Learn classes, we have significantly reduced our reliance on the CNA registry, saving us $50,000 per month. CNAP’s support has empowered us to build a sustainable workforce and further enhance our patient care and satisfaction. We look forward to our continued partnership.”

inventory.text: CNAP Financial Awards Partner with CNAP and take advantage of the various financial awards that are available to benefit SNF workforce development initiatives in California. You may be eligible for multiple awards depending on your facilities needs and goals, and may apply for all awards through one single application. Applications must be received for each facility independently. All CNAP Awardees will receive a direct introduction to their local Workforce Development Board (WDB) for invaluable resources. NATP Approval Second DSD Earn & Learn CNA Upskilling Clinical Rotation Facility-Based NATP Approval Award: $2,000 Facility-Based NATP: SNF is CDPH accredited to conduct both theory and clinical training for CNAs. Alternative NATP: SNF partners with an accredited online NATP for theory training while conducting the clinical component on-site. Become NATP Approved: Development and Approval of a Facility-Based NATP Webinar Facilities who are successful in receiving a 2023 or later CDPH Facility-based (or Alternative*) NATP approval or renewal notice for CNA training will receive a maximum award of $2,000. * Alternative: Partnering with an approved CDPH online training program per AFL 20-89.1 Required documentation: Facility W9 Form (please note the most current W9) The original 280A form that confirms your 2023 or later approval or renewal status as a facility-based NATP (see example) Apply Now 2nd Director of Staff Development (DSD) Award: $2,000 one award per facility Facilities with two or more Directors of Staff Development will receive a one-time award of $2,000. Required documentation: Facility W9 form (please note the most current W9) Employee I9s (see example) (DOB, ID information & Social Security # may be redacted) Certifications of both DSDs (see example) Apply Now Earn-and-Learn Program Award: $2,000 per certified Earn & Learn CNA Earn and Learn: Students are employees - ALL educational and competency testing fees are covered, and hourly wages paid through NA training Become NATP Approved: Development and Approval of a Facility-Based NATP Webinar Establish a partnership with a facility-based or community-based Earn and Learn Program Facilities that provide Earn and Learn programs in conjunction with a CDPH approved NATP will receive $2,000 per certified CNA. Unlimited each year while annual funds are available. Required documents for all E&L awards: Facility W9 form (please note the most current W9) Employee I-9s (see example) (DOB, ID information & Social Security # may be redacted) CNA License Verifications – after your cohort is completed (see example) Apply Now CUSP Program Implementation (Upskilling) Award: $2,000 Facilities that participate in the CUSP program will be awarded a one-time award of $2,000 after at least one CNA and one Supervisor have completed trainings. To participate in CUSP Implementation, all 3 portions of CUSP need to be agreed to (1. Allow all CNA employees that meet criteria to participate in CUSP 2. Consider an incremental, standardized wage increase for each CUSP level attained and 3. Acknowledgment of new employee’s pre-existing CNA CUSP level of achievement upon hire.) Required documentation: Facility W9 form (please note the most current W9 Apply Now CUSP Credentialing Award: $600 per CNA Cert. Facilities that support CNA upskilling through the CUSP program and successfully complete levels II-IV will receive $600 per certification. View CUSP Certifications * If an existing CNA employee has been on the floor for 6 months and meets the employer eligibility criteria, the CNA may advance through levels II-IV without the incremental 4 weeks in-between levels. Apply Now CUSP sUPERVISOR AWARD: $750 per Course (4) 4 awards per facility Facilities that participate in the CUSP program and certify a designated staff licensed nurse to be the supervisor trainer to oversee the CUSP skill competency checks will receive $750 per training course up to 4 courses per facility. Apply Now Clinical Rotation Hosting Award: $25 per student Facilities certified to host clinical rotations will receive an award of $25 per student hosted since January 1, 2023. Required documentation: Facility W9 form (please note the most current W9) List of student names and their clinical date on CNA School Letterhead ( see example Apply Now Testimonials Oak River Rehab “While the application process at first seemed a bit daunting, once the CNAP team walked me through everything, it was super easy to submit all of the required documents. From there on out, we only saw great benefits through our relationship with CNAP, including the care that our Earn and Learn CNA graduates are now delivering in our facility.” Chad Kanow , Assistant Administrator , Oak River Rehab Kern Valley “CNAP awards have allowed us to continue to offer this program with a reduced demand on facilities resources! It is very easy to work with the CNAP staff! The application process is simple, they explain everything, and it is well organized. We feel incredibly supported!” Brandy Arana, Administrator and NATP Coordinator, Kern Valley Crystal Ridge Care Center "Without knowing the process, the CNAP application can seem a bit daunting, but once you work with the CNAP team, the process is really streamlined, not complicated at all. The staff is so supportive." - Daenen Miller, Administrator, Crystal Ridge Care Center The Pines at Placerville "We just received our first check for the CNAP program for the 18 CNAs that we put through our CNA class. All our interactions with Mai and Zane have been nothing short of amazing. They were with us the entire way and felt invested in our success. Their instructions were clear and concise, and they went above and beyond to ensure we received our reward. We will gladly continue to work with them in future cohorts and are grateful for this partnership." - Colby Hollingsworth, Administrator Southern Inyo Healthcare District “We are thrilled with the CNAP funds received as they have provided us with the financial flexibility to enhance our classrooms and work stations for both our employee students and long-term staff. Thanks to CNAP we can invest in improvements that directly benefit our learning environment and support our educational goals. The process of accessing the funds was straightforward and we appreciate the opportunity to utilize them for our specific needs. CNAP has truly made a positive impact on our facility, and we look forward to our continued partnership.” -Jennifer Emley, Quality Assistant Fallbrook Skilled Nursing “Our experience with the CNAP program has been incredibly beneficial to our facility. With our second cohort of Earn and Learn students graduating soon and another one planned for the near future, CNAP has played a vital role in addressing our staffing needs. Thanks to the Earn and Learn classes, we have significantly reduced our reliance on the CNA registry, saving us $50,000 per month. CNAP’s support has empowered us to build a sustainable workforce and further enhance our patient care and satisfaction. We look forward to our continued partnership.” -Robert Durban, Administrator Golden Heights Healthcare “Thanks to the valuable guidance and support from CNAP staff and the CNAP Resources, our facility navigated the accreditation process and successfully obtained our facility based NATP approval. This achievement not only brought us multiple financial rewards but has also empowered us to hire and train our own CNAs. We are now eagerly preparing to launch an Earn and Learn program, with the goal of building a sustainable and renewable workforce.” -Almaroof Apatira, Administrator Kern Valley Healthcare District "CNAP has aided us with graduating 12 Nurse Assistant Students, successfully passing their state exams to obtain their certifications. The application process is simple and well organized. CNAP awards have allowed us to continue to offer this program with a reduced demand on facilities resources and has offered us a great deal more support than just financial awards. Earn and Learn helps increase our retention of newly trained and certified CNA’s!" -Brandy Arana, LMS Administrator and NATP Coordinator Compass Health, Inc. "Quality Care Health Foundation’s Certified Nursing Assistant Program has been a welcome resource in supporting our goals of training and retaining CNAs. The CNAP program team was easy to work with and supportive throughout the award application and disbursement process. They kept their requests concise, were realistic with deliverable due dates and sent reminders when needed." - Patrick Woolpert, Finance Director Cambridge Health Services "Our experience working with CNAP has been wonderful. Megan was clear and concise with all instructions and also easy to reach if I had any questions. I have felt supported throughout the entire process. As we endeavor to train the best CNAs to support our residents, this grant has made the process so much easier. The support has allowed us to continue to grow our program which only benefits our facilities and residents! We look forward to our future partnership with CNAP in the coming years!" - Jenny Rivera, Cambridge Health Services LONG-TERM CARE EMPLOYERS Invest in Your Facility's Future with CNAP Employers: Sign Up Now Employer Resources Directory of Nurse Assistant Training Programs (CNA Training Providers) in California CDPH Facility- and Community-based NATPs Learn more Recruiting Refugees and Immigrants into the CNA Workforce Toolkit created by the International Rescue Committee Learn more Contracting with a Community Based NATP Webinar on how to apply for a contract with a community-based NATP Learn more Hosting a Community-Based NATP Webinar focused on the application process for hosting a clinical site Learn more Development & Approval of Facility-Based NATP Application Webinar for administrators seeking to establish a NATP in their facility Learn more Apply for Awards Partner with CNAP and take advantage of the various financial awards available.
